ATTRIBUTION
-----------
ufc-master.csv is the "Ultimate UFC Dataset" by Matt Dabbert (mdabbert),
licensed Apache-2.0. The licence is the LICENSE file beside this one.

It is the betting-odds source: American moneyline prices for roughly 6,900
bouts with both-side odds, 2010-03-21 to 2026-03-28. It backs odds_lines.parquet
as an external benchmark and the missed-weight cross-check, joined on the
fighter pair and the event date.

Apache-2.0 requires attribution and permits redistribution, which is why the
file is carried here rather than fetched.

The dataset is published on Kaggle as "Ultimate UFC Dataset"; the copy vendored
here arrived as a download named ultimate_ufc_dataset-main. No upstream GitHub
repository could be confirmed for it on 2026-09-22, so no repository URL is
claimed.
